events.what: Fibred FJC for suspensions of one-ended hyperbolic groups and many relatively hyperbolic groups, and for automorphism groups of one-ended groups hyperbolic relative to virtually polycyclic subgroups (arXiv:2311.14036; Math. Ann. 2026)
FJC for many hierarchically hyperbolic groups, including extra-large-type Artin groups, via asymptotically CAT(0) metrics and Z-structures (arXiv:2504.17048)
Lück survey of the Farrell-Jones conjecture (arXiv:2507.11337, Bull. AMS)

judgement.doubts: Codes agree with the record. The researcher correctly dated arXiv:2311.14036 to its November 2023 v1 (F7), so it cannot carry the status. The status rests on the April 2025 hierarchically hyperbolic groups preprint: it settles a case (a class of groups), and whether anyone has reviewed it does not change the partial tier. The record wrongly treats the Lück survey as digesting that paper; the survey is scope none and does not count as verifying it. That has no effect on the codes. credited_humans is left empty because the record gives no author names.
